title: Write Binary File
text: Write binary video data to file, 5 inputs, {Four character code} sets Format of binary file; {File name} sets the name of the binary, {Video format} sets the format of the video data Four character, {Line ordering} sets the binary file fill direction Top, {Bit stream format} sets the data format of binary, {Number of inputs} sets the number of components in input video stream, {Inherit size of components from input data type} sets the all components have same number of bits, {Component1} sets the name of luminance component input port Y, {Component2} sets the name of blue difference, {Component3} sets the name of red difference, {Component4} sets the name of alpha, {Bits1} sets the size of luminance component, {Bits2} sets the size of blue difference component, {Bits3} sets the size of red difference component, {Bits4} sets the size of alpha component, {Component order in binary file} sets the arrangement of components in binary file, {Interlaced video} sets the read video data as interlaced, {Write signed data to output file} sets the write signed data to output binary file and {Byte order in binary file} sets the byte order in output binary file Little. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Y’
ports.summary: Luminance component of input video stream scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Cb
ports.summary: Blue difference component of the input video stream scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Cr
ports.summary: Red difference component of input video stream scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: A
ports.summary: Alpha component of input video stream scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: T
ports.summary: Transparency component of input video stream scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: File name
params.values: Name of the binary file output.bin (default) | file name

params.name: Video format
params.values: Format of the video data Four character codes (default) | Custom

params.name: Four character code
params.values: Format of binary file I420 (default) | AYUV | CLJR | cyuv | GREY | IF09 | IMC1 | IMC2 | IMC3 | IMC4 | IUYV | IY41 | IYU1 | IYU2 | IYUV | NV12 | NV21 | UYNV | UYNY | V210 | Y411 | Y41P | Y41T | Y422 | Y42T | Y8 | Y800 | YUNV | YUY2 | YUYV | YV12 | YV16 | YVU9 | YVYU |...

params.name: Line ordering
params.values: Binary file fill direction Top line first (default) | Bottom line first

params.name: Bit stream format
params.values: Data format of binary file Planar (default) | Packed

params.name: Number of inputs
params.values: Number of components in input video stream 3 (default) | 1 | 2 | 4

params.name: Inherit size of components from input data type
params.values: All components have same number of bits on (default) | off

params.name: Component1
params.values: Name of luminance component input port Y’ (default) | component name

params.name: Component2
params.values: Name of blue difference component Cb (default) | component name

params.name: Component3
params.values: Name of red difference component Cr (default) | component name

params.name: Component4
params.values: Name of alpha component Alpha (default) | component name

params.name: Component order in binary file
params.values: Arrangement of components in binary file [ 1 2 3 ] (default) | vector of valid component identifiers

params.name: Interlaced video
params.values: Read video data as interlaced off (default) | on

params.name: Write signed data to output file
params.values: Write signed data to output binary file off (default) | on

params.name: Byte order in binary file
params.values: Byte order in output binary file Little endian (default) | Big endian
